parties: Heineken UK Limited | United Breweries Limited
headline: Heineken UK Limited Files Substantial Acquisition Disclosure Under SEBI Takeover Regulations for United Breweries
sum: Heineken UK Limited has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE for a substantial acquisition in United Breweries Limited. The filing triggers mandatory SEBI takeover code compliance for acquisitions exceeding the 25% threshold.
implication: A Reg. 31(4) disclosure is a gating filing required within 2 business days of crossing 25% shareholding; its presence signals the acquiror has either crossed or is announcing a firm intention to cross the threshold, triggering full takeover code obligations (open offer, board representation, share-pooling restrictions) and requires careful structuring of timing and conditionality.
detail: Heineken UK Limited submitted to NSE a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This regulation requires disclosure when a person acquires or agrees to acquire shares that result in shareholding of 25% or more. The filing is a primary gating compliance trigger for any substantial acquisition in a listed Indian company and sets the clock for open offer, board seat, and regulatory approvals.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4)
framework.note: Mandatory disclosure within 2 business days of crossing 25% shareholding or firm agreement to acquire; central trigger for takeover code compliance.
Defines person acquiring shares and related party thresholds; governs who is deemed an acquirer for open offer purposes.
Mandatory open offer to public shareholders when acquirer reaches 25%+; sets offer price, validity, settlement terms.
Lists exemptions (e.g., govt., acquisition from open market, negotiated acquisition if <90% acceptance). Heineken may seek exemption from open offer.
On crossing 25%, acquirer typically entitled to nominate director(s) to board; Section 165 fiduciary duties apply.

framework.ref: Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999 (FEMA) & FDI Policy
framework.note: Foreign investor (Heineken UK) must comply with FDI limits in multi-brand retail/F&B sector; likely requires government approval.

framework.ref: Monopolies and Restrictive Trade Practices Act (MRTP) / Competition Act, 2002, Section 6 (combination approval)
framework.note: If deal value triggers CCI threshold (₹2,000 cr or asset/revenue thresholds), CCI combination approval required pre-close.
FDI acquisition requires compliance with source of funds verification and beneficial ownership disclosure.

framework.ref: Listing Agreement & LODR (Securities and Exchange Board of India) (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
framework.note: UBL must disclose material acquisition by promoter/substantial shareholder; Heineken's acquisition is material.

conditions: Shareholding acquisition by Heineken UK Limited reaching or exceeding 25%
SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure filing with NSE within 2 business days of crossing threshold
Mandatory open offer to existing public shareholders (if not exempted under Reg. 15)
Foreign investment approval (if applicable under FDI policy)
CCI combination approval (if transaction value exceeds thresholds)
approvals: SEBI Takeover Regulation compliance (Reg. 31(4) disclosure filed)
FDI / Government of India approval (if foreign direct investment rules apply)
structure.novel: Standard substantial acquisition by foreign entity in listed Indian beverage company; filing confirms acquiror has crossed or is firm on 25% threshold.

triggers.note: Disclosure mandatory on crossing 25%; gates all downstream takeover code compliance.

triggers.note: Foreign acquiror; sector-specific FDI caps and approval routes must be verified.
Threshold-based combination review by CCI if deal size triggers asset/revenue tests.
